project_rules.name: Project Rules
project_rules.description: Architecture contracts, phase boundaries, tensor shapes, graph adjacency, reward hygiene

optional_flags.checkpoint: Path to checkpoint for resuming training or playback

mandatory_constraints: Architecture and interfaces documented in docs/architecture.md
Phase boundary protection: no premature Phase 3+ implementation
Tensor shape comments required on first access (shape: [dims])
Graph adjacency contract: extras['adj_matrix'] must be [num_envs, num_agents, num_agents] with diagonal zeros
All reward terms must have scale in config, disabled terms set to 0.0 (not commented)
No magic numbers in environment core: all tunable parameters in config
documentation_requirements: Module docstrings: one-line summary at file top
Function/class docstrings: required for all public interfaces
Reward changes logged in docs/status/changelog.md with rationale

current_goals: Train GATv2 with MAPPO on formation task
Test basic formation keeping in empty space

phase_5.milestone: M3 & M4: Mission validation + HD demo with 20+ agents

goals.description: Establish a scalable coordination policy using graph-based learning
Achieve mathematically optimal flight paths for swarm agents (via MINCO)
Ensure mission continuity despite individual drone failures (via SwarmRaft)
Create professional-grade visual validation of swarm autonomy

technical_objectives.target: HD video of 20+ agents navigating cluttered forest

risk_mitigations.mitigation: Headless training locally, offload heavy workloads to cloud (Brev A100)

notes.active_training: As of 2026-03-20, Phase 2 GATv2 training is active with 32 parallel environments on CUDA
setup_requirements: Python 3.11 virtual environment with Isaac Lab installed
H5PY pinning on Windows: pip install 'h5py>=3.9.0,<3.12' --force-reinstall
Long path support enabled on Windows (LongPathsEnabled = 1)

adjacency_matrix.invariant: diagonal must be all zeros (no self-edges)

rewards.note: Sum of scaled reward terms from config
